question: To whom and under what test must a particular transmission be given rather than withheld?
premises: A particular transmission is fit to be given.
It is to be given only to one previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one full year.
inference: The transmission is to be given only to a previously accomplished person who has been tested for one year.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
